purpose: Teach: 微分/散らし/弁明/欺瞞/排泄/捕鯨/抗争/殺戮

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、微分方程式の社会応用を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper on the social applications of differential equations — you handled that well, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, genuine curiosity. Lean forward slightly. Teacher voice — interested in the student's thinking, not performing assessment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、チラシを散らした運動の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I looked at the history of flyer-distribution campaigns and how they shaped social movements.
lines.style: Direct and clear. Respectful but confident in what she's saying. Meeting the teacher's eye without hesitation. Present tense in the mind.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治家の弁明の修辞を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your other paper — the one on political rhetoric and how officials defend their positions. That was an interesting choice.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle probing tone, not interrogating. Slight tilt of head. Teacher noticing something deliberate in the student's selection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、宣伝の欺瞞表現を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I examined deceptive language in advertising — how it works, where it shows up, what it tries to hide.
lines.style: Steady delivery, matter-of-fact. She's thought about this deeply. No apology in her voice. Speaking from knowledge, not guessing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 排泄物処理の都市史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also wrote about urban history and sewage systems. That's not what most students choose to study.
lines.style: Genuine interest, no judgment. Pause before 'sewage systems' — teacher recognizing an unexpected intellectual choice. Warm baseline.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、国際捕鯨規制の論争を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I was interested in how cities solved that problem, how the solutions revealed what a society valued and didn't.
lines.style: Thoughtful but not hesitant. She's defending her choice without being defensive. Speaking as though explaining something she understands completely.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 二十世紀の暴力団抗争史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And then there was your paper on gang conflict in the twentieth century. That's quite a range of subjects you've chosen.
lines.style: Slower pace, more measured. Teacher voice registering the pattern — noticing something the student might not have said aloud. Not accusatory, just observant.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の殺戮事件を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I examined specific incidents during wartime — the circumstances, the causes, what happened afterward.
lines.style: Quieter now. Still composed but a layer deeper. She's meeting the teacher's observation head-on. Words chosen carefully. No trailing off.
